annotations.title: Day pillar for a date · 日柱

description: Returns the BaZi day pillar (stem-branch of the sixty-day cycle) for a Gregorian date, or for today if no date is given. For a birth date this is also the day master, the centre of a BaZi chart, which needs only the date. Includes the stem element, branch animal, hidden stems, Na Yin, the day-master image and motto, the month and year pillars, the solar term in effect and the lunar date, plus a note on the 11 pm day-change convention. Deterministic calendar facts from the Auspice Oracle engine, 1900–2100; no interpretation or prediction.

lang.description: Language of the rendered output — pass the language the user is conversing in. Defaults to 'en'.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone that decides which date 'today' is when no date is given (default Asia/Shanghai)
